inferred_or_tuned.line_search: Original distinct per-block alpha backtracking: each block uses actual projected/retracted displacement Armijo. The jointly combined block step is checked with total actual-displacement Armijo and is commonly scaled only if necessary; this coupling safeguard and constants are not specified in the paper. Common-alpha mode remains diagnostic only.
inferred_or_tuned.initialization: Portable Park-Miller phases, independent positive simplex entries then row normalization; seed not published.
inferred_or_tuned.scheduling_recovery: Largest relaxed entry, smallest index on exact tie; paper specifies thresholding but not its threshold.
inferred_or_tuned.non_descent: Raw per-block PR coefficients and slopes are preserved and recorded. A block restarts minus its current gradient if either its raw tangent slope or its initial-step feasible projected displacement slope is nonnegative; raw_non_descent and projected_non_descent reasons are recorded separately. Exact zero-gradient/empty blocks and zero projected boundary motions are inactive. The source specifies an open simplex but its Euclidean projection reaches the closed boundary; this documented numerical safeguard reports raw row-mean and projected/KKT norms separately, using the latter for guarded stopping. literal_printed retains raw-direction diagnostics. No feasibility tolerance is relaxed.
inferred_or_tuned.distance: Ambient product norm for outer step; intrinsic product distance not numerically specified.
inferred_or_tuned.angles: Recovered original EPS axes/markers: azimuth phi inclusive 0 to 90 degrees, elevation theta inclusive 30 to 70 degrees, elevation-major target ordering. Eq3c defines these symbols; Numerical Results swaps the two angle ranges. Count1 uses azimuth45/elevation50. Sweeps share these recovered ranges; intermediate grids are reconstructed uniformly, not fitted to output curves.
inferred_or_tuned.closed_form_origin: Both layers use the same declared zero coordinate reference, with no MS2-only offset. The ordinary-positive-field convention is the conjugate-equivalent implementation Phi=-A(x^2+y^2), Theta=+A(x^2+y^2) of the source positive-phase/negative-field formulation. Scheduled positive displacements use the original analytic law and nearest integer index. The finite coordinate reference is explicit; the historical original finite-pattern settings remain unrecovered.
inferred_or_tuned.stable_objective_difference: Exact algebraic increments of |q|^2, quartic echo, fractional SINR, schedule-weighted residual and augmented-Lagrangian active squares are used for Armijo differences to avoid subtraction cancellation. This evaluates the same mathematical objective, with no accepted-value slack, relaxed tolerances or algorithm replacement.
inferred_or_tuned.exhausted_direction_restart: If a raw PR block exhausts the original backtracking budget, the documented numerical safeguard restarts only that block as minus its current projected gradient and repeats the same Armijo test. This optional guard is explicitly recorded; PR remains the production conjugate-gradient update. Genuine failures are preserved rather than marked converged.
inferred_or_tuned.stopping: Numerical paragraph AND chosen explicitly; Algorithm 2 says OR. Both retained as selectable options.
inferred_or_tuned.feasibility: 1e-6 max q feasibility tolerance selected; original best-feasible numerical tolerance absent.
inferred_or_tuned.pslr: Original rectangular guard azimuth +/-22.5 degrees and elevation +/-10 degrees; dense60x60 grid retained over recovered target region phi0..90/theta30..70. Exact intermediate grid samples, clutter beta equal targets, epsilon1e-12 and mu10 halved to1e-3 are inferred, not original quoted values.
inferred_or_tuned.ris_baseline: Independent phase optimization per target by same RALM/RCG, continuous design followed by nearest phase quantization for 1-bit/2-bit. Original baseline optimizer not specified.
inferred_or_tuned.grids: Sweep point grids recovered from EPS axis ticks/legends and integer geometry. These may differ from unpublished intermediate plotting samples.
inferred_or_tuned.normalization: The effective_reference_gain_factor=100 candidate is inferred from the complete original continuous-RIS six-power fingerprint, with fixed full aperture/targets and original RALM per-start budgets; no fitted phase or changed algorithm. Author PRI count/reference-unit recovery remains unverified.

settings.normalization_note: All six original continuous-RIS points identify an effective 100-fold reference/noise factor to EPS precision. Its physical origin is not unique: coherent PRI integration, processed-noise normalization or a reference-level difference could give the same SINR. This candidate does NOT claim the source explicitly reports Tp=100. Physical transmit power remains 30 dBm = 1 W. Full figure start/iteration budgets remain unchanged.

compaction_note: Only inner RCG iteration histories omitted. All point/target metrics, phase states, outer updates, residuals and actual stop flags retained. No convergence or complete-figure certification inferred.
